entries.title: Psalms 126:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. {turned...: Heb. returned the returning}

words.text: , we were like them that dream

entries.title: Psalms 126:2
segments: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them. {hath...: Heb. hath magnified to do with them}

words.text: for them. {hath...: Heb. hath magnified to do with them}

entries.title: Psalms 126:3
segments: The LORD hath done great things for us; [whereof] we are glad.

entries.title: Psalms 126:4
segments: ¶Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.

entries.title: Psalms 126:5
segments: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy. {joy: or, singing}

entries.title: Psalms 126:6
segments: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves [with him]. {precious...: or, seed basket}
